annotations.title: Check an IBAN against the supplier's ledger

description: The anti-BEC step: compares the IBAN read on an invoice with that supplier's history and says whether it is already confirmed, seen but never confirmed, or NEVER SEEN. WARNING, this tool CHANGES state: a never-seen IBAN is recorded as "awaiting confirmation" and the account holder receives a warning email. Confirming an IBAN is NOT exposed to agents: it is an act that requires a person, and is done at https://imperioutils.com/tools/supplier-monitors. Requires an API key (free account at https://imperioutils.com/signup). Consumes no credits.

iban.description: IBAN shown on the document to be paid.

partita_iva.description: Supplier's Italian VAT number (Partita IVA, with or without IT prefix).

vat_number.description: Alias of `partita_iva` (Italian VAT number): the same value, accepted because other tools of this server use this name. If you send both names, the values must match.
